snippet.title: Hear Tell of Hauntings - Reveal Trailer (HD)
snippet.description:
The trailer for Hear Tell of Hauntings, a third-person old west survival horror game being developed by Two Stamp Studios.

WISHLIST IT HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3410390/Hear_Tell_of_Hauntings/

The year is 1897. Deep in the mountains of Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy sets off to find her missing friend and uncover the mystery that shrouds the Wraith estate. Solve puzzles, fight monsters, and introduce yourself to the inhabitants of the manor. 

#gaming #trailer #survivalhorror #indie
